claims: Dusty May is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Michigan.
Dusty May was hired in March 2024 to replace Juwan Howard.
Dusty May led the Wolverines to the 2026 Final Four in his second season.
Dusty May reached the 2023 Final Four at Florida Atlantic University.
Dusty May was head coach at Florida Atlantic University from 2018 to 2024.
Dusty May was the 2023 Conference USA Coach of the Year.
Dusty May signed a new contract in February 2025.
Dusty May played at Indiana University.
Kim Barnes Arico is the women's basketball coach at the University of Michigan.
